title: 第908章 迎接新的时代第907章 宴请魔族势力
slug: 反派神子开局送主角九族消消乐
content_zh:
听到这个名字。
他的眼神明显变化了一瞬。
这一幕。
自然没有逃过炎璃的注意。
“怎么？”
陈归尘沉默片刻。
随后摇头。
“只是听闻过一些。”
“毕竟姜族在万魔天城做出的事情，如今整个魔界都知道。”
炎璃点头。
“确实。”
“那一族，很强。”
说到这里，她又笑了笑。
“不过你不用太紧张。”
“此次只是正常宴会。”
陈归尘没有回答，心中却微微沉了下来。
正常交流？
自己之前被姜族暗中追查，不断追缉。
虽然最近一个多月，姜族没有再派人寻找自己。
但越是如此。

陈归尘越觉得古怪。
按照正常情况。
以姜族的能力，不太可能突然放弃。
陈归尘忍不住皱眉。
“公主。”
“这一次万魔天城之行，会不会有危险？”
炎璃看着他，轻笑一声。
“怎么？”
“你是在担心我？”
陈归尘一顿。
随后认真道：
“公主这些日子待我不薄。”
“若真有什么危险，我自然不能坐视不理。”
炎璃眸光微微闪动。
对于这个回答，她似乎很满意。
“放心。”
“如今万魔天城有诸位魔皇魔帝坐镇。”
“姜族再强，也不会在这种地方乱来。”
陈归尘点头。
但心中依旧没有完全放松。

他其实已经想过拒绝，甚至想找个理由暂时避开。
可看着炎璃那张倾国倾城的面容。
以及这段时间对自己的照顾。
最终。
他还是答应下来。

His eyes obviously changed for a moment.
This scene.

"What?"
Chen Guichen was silent for a moment.
Then he shook his head.
"I just heard about it."
"After all, what the Jiang clan did in Ten Thousand Demons Heavenly City is now known to the entire demon world."
Yan Li nodded.
"Indeed."
"That clan is very strong."
At this point, she smiled again.
"But you don't need to be too nervous."
"This is just a normal banquet."
Chen Guichen didn't answer, but his heart sank slightly.
Normal communication?
He had been secretly pursued by the Jiang clan before and was constantly being pursued.
Although in the past month or so, the Jiang clan has not sent anyone to look for him.
But the more so.
Chen Guichen felt more and more weird.
As per normal conditions.
With the ability of the Jiang clan, it is unlikely that they would give up suddenly.
Chen Guichen couldn't help but frown.
"Princess."
"Will there be any danger during this trip to the Demon City?"
Yanli looked at him and chuckled.
"What?"
"Are you worried about me?"
Chen Guichen paused.
Then he said seriously:
"Princess has been treating me well these days."
"If there is really any danger, I naturally can't just sit back and ignore it."
Yanli's eyes flashed slightly.
She seemed satisfied with this answer.
"Don't worry."
"Now there are various demon kings and demon emperors sitting in the Ten Thousand Demons Heavenly City."
"No matter how strong the Jiang clan is, they will never mess around in a place like this."
Chen Guichen nodded.
But my heart is still not completely relaxed.
He had actually thought about refusing, and even wanted to find a reason to avoid it temporarily.
But looking at Yan Li's face, he was so captivating.
And take care of yourself during this time.
final.
He agreed anyway.
